IMPORTANT NOTICE
Candidates are hereby informed to go through the Information Bulletin carefully and acquaint
themselves with the following instructions:
1. Candidates must apply online only.
2. The Information Bulletin can be downloaded from the University website:
https://www.kvafsu.edu.in
3. Online submission of the Application Form must be done by accessing the KVAFSU
website: https://www.kvafsu.edu.in
4. Candidates must strictly follow the instructions given in the Information Bulletin and the
updates published on the KVAFSU website. Candidates failing to comply with these
instructions shall be summarily disqualified.
5. Candidates must retain the following documents for future reference:
i. At least two printouts of the finally submitted online application form.
ii. Proof of fee payment.
iii. 2–3 copies of the identical photograph that was scanned and uploaded with the online
application.
6. Candidates must ensure that all information provided in the online application form is
accurate and true to the best of their knowledge. Any discrepancy may lead to
disqualification.
7. Candidates must ensure that the mobile number(s) and email address entered in the online
application form are their own, as any urgent information/communication from KVAFSU
will be sent by SMS or email to the given mobile number and email ID only.
8. The candidate/parents shall be solely responsible for non-receipt of information due to
incorrect mobile number or email address provided in the online application form.
9. For the latest updates, candidates must regularly visit the KVAFSU website:
https://www.kvafsu.edu.in until the completion of the counselling process.
10. Candidates/parents are advised to check the KVAFSU website regularly for the latest updates
and also monitor their mobile phones and email, as KVAFSU may send urgent
information/communication through these channels.
11. KVAFSU reserves the right to withdraw any admission at any point of time if it is found that
the eligibility criteria/regulations fixed by the Competent Authority from time to time are not
fulfilled.
12. If any information submitted or documents produced by the candidate are found to be
fraudulent, incorrect, or untrue at any stage during admission or the course of the degree
programme, the admission shall be cancelled, the candidate will be debarred from the college
without further reference, and the fees paid shall be forfeited.

INTRODUCTION
Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and Fisheries Sciences University, Bidar
Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and Fisheries Sciences University, Bidar was established as per the
Karnataka Act No. 9 of 2004 called “The Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and Fisheries University
Act 2004” and published in the Karnataka Gazette Extra-Ordinary on the 23rd day of February, 2004.
The University is established exclusively for providing education, conduct of research and extension
in the areas of Veterinary, Animal, Dairy and Fisheries Sciences in the state of Karnataka. The logo
of the University is inscribed with the slogan “Farmers Friendly and Rural Oriented”, which
emphasizes the importance given to betterment of farming community.
KVAFSU is an autonomous academic institution governed by its Board of Management which
regulates the policies of the university in accordance with the provision of act and statutes. The
University administration also has the support of the Finance Committee. Academic matters are
looked after by the Board of Studies and the Academic Council while Research Council and
Extension Education Council decide the research and extension activities of the University,
respectively.
The University offers undergraduate Degree programs in Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry
Sciences at six constituent Veterinary Colleges at Bidar, Bengaluru, Shivamogga, Hassan, Gadag
and Athani while Dairy Sciences are being offered at Dairy Science College, Bengaluru and
Kalaburgi and College of Fisheries, Mangaluru, respectively.
RGR/ACAD/ADMN/4/2025-ACDM-KVAFSU I/74121/2025
2 | P a g e
CONSTITUENT COLLEGES OF KVAFSU, BIDAR
I. Veterinary College, Bengaluru
The Veterinary College, Bangalore was inaugurated on 25th July, 1958, by the then Honorable Chief
Minister of Karnataka Shri.B.D.Jatti and started functioning in Mysore serum institute, now called
Institute of Animal Health and Veterinary Biologicals (IAH & VB).
The present college campus, located in the 196 acres plot was inaugurated by His Highness the
Maharaja Shri Jaya Chamarajendra Wodeyar, the Governor of Karnataka, on 6th January 1962 and
the same was then affiliated to Mysore University, Mysore. In 1965, the college became the
constituent college of the University of Agricultural Sciences, Bangalore under trimester system of
education in-line with land-grant system of education. In 2004, after the establishment of Karnataka
Veterinary Animal and Fisheries Sciences University (KVAFSU), the college has become the part of
the Veterinary University. The College celebrated its golden jubilee year from September 2007 to
August 2008.
To meet these challenges, the college has nineteen well equipped departments with highly qualified
and skilled staff involved in offering B.V.Sc & AH programme as per Veterinary Council of India
regulations. The college is also involved in offering Masters and Doctoral program in seventeen and
fourteen disciplines respectively. Besides the college has well equipped hospital at Hebbal and
Yelahanka with state of art facility for teaching, research as well as for to serve the farming
community. The college has instructional farm that includes dairy, sheep, piggery, poultry farm and
experimental small animal unit.
RGR/ACAD/ADMN/4/2025-ACDM-KVAFSU I/74121/2025
3 | P a g e
II. Veterinary College, Bidar
The College was established in 1984 under University of Agricultural Sciences Bengaluru and later
became a constituent college of University of Agricultural Sciences, Dharwad during 1986 and
subsequent a constituent college of KVASFU in April 2005 located at Nandinagar, Kamatana Road,
Bidar
The College is offering B.V.Sc. & A.H degree programme as per Minimum Standard of Veterinary
Education (MSVE) 2016 regulations of Veterinary Council of India, New Delhi for the students
admitted from the academic year 2017-2018. The College is having 17 teaching departments
including Veterinary Clinical Complex (VCC) and Livestock Farm Complex (LFC). In addition
post-graduate (M.V.Sc.) and Doctoral degree programme is also offered in selected subjects from
academic year 1995-96 in accordance with the ICAR guidelines.
III. Veterinary College, Shivamogga
Shivamogga is endowed with rich natural resources including animal genetic resources, heritage of
culture, traditional and social systems and is being considered as lead centre in education activities.
Veterinary College, Shivamogga recognized under Veterinary Council of India, New Delhi, was
RGR/ACAD/ADMN/4/2025-ACDM-KVAFSU I/74121/2025
4 | P a g e
established in the Year 2006 and started functioning in the NSS building of the Sahyadri Science
College on 11.09.2006.
Presently, the College is functioning in the main campus in an area of 172.18 acres at Vinobangara
near Sominakoppa, Shivamogga. with well established infrastructure. In this college, adequate
measures are taken to assure quality education, as the college is governed by the requirements of
Veterinary Council of India and guidelines of the KVAFSU, Bidar.
The College is offering B.V.Sc. & A.H degree programme as per Minimum Standard of Veterinary
Education (MSVE) 2008 and 2016 regulations of Veterinary Council of India, New Delhi for the
students admitted from the academic year 2009-2010 and 2016-17 onwards respectively. The
College is having 17 teaching departments including Veterinary Clinical Complex (VCC) and
Livestock Farm Complex (LFC). Master’s degree programme (M.V.Sc) are being offered in 13
disciplines and Doctoral Degree in 2 discipline.
IV. Veterinary College, Hassan
Veterinary College, Hassan (HVC), emerged as the fourth constituent Veterinary College of
KVAFSU, Bidar on 16th August 2007. The HVC is located at the fringes of Hassan city, sprawling
across about 80 acres the beautiful campus of HVC has been blessed with fertile soil, lakes, counters
and farm land. Magnificent main building has been one of the unique government structures of the
district coupled with an adjacent state-of-the art Veterinary Hospital. The beautiful campus of HVC
has hostels (boys and girls), well equipped sports complex with pavilion for indoor and outdoor
games including multi-gym facility, livestock farms, residential quarters and guest house buildings.
The college offers undergraduate B.V.Sc. & A.H. degree programme as per Veterinary Council of
RGR/ACAD/ADMN/4/2025-ACDM-KVAFSU I/74121/2025
5 | P a g e
India (VCI) standards. The HVC has 18 departments and equipped laboratories to meet the
requirements of the minimum standards of veterinary education (MSVE). In addition post-graduate
(M.V.Sc.) degree programme is also offered in accordance with the ICAR guidelines.
V. Veterinary College, Gadag
Gadag is a place primarily known for dry land agriculture. The place inherits its pride of place in the
fields of culture, tradition, music and printing. Veterinary College, Gadag recognized under
Veterinary Council of India, New Delhi, was established in the Year 2017 and started functioning in
own building on 25.09.2017 with initial intake of 50 students.
Presently, the College is functioning in the main campus in an area of 162 acres on Hombal road,
Gadag. with well established infrastructure. In this college, adequate measures are taken to assure
quality education, as the college is governed by the requirements of Veterinary Council of India and
guidelines of the KVAFSU, Bidar.
The College is offering B.V.Sc. & A.H degree programme as per Minimum Standard of Veterinary
Education (MSVE) 2016 regulations of Veterinary Council of India, New Delhi for the students
admitted from the academic year 2017-2018. The College is having 17 teaching departments
including Veterinary Clinical Complex (VCC) and Livestock Farm Complex (LFC).
RGR/ACAD/ADMN/4/2025-ACDM-KVAFSU I/74121/2025
6 | P a g e
VI. Sri Bahurao Deshpande Veterinary College, Athani, Belagavi
Shri. Bahurao Deshpande Veterinary College Athani was sanctioned in the year 2010 by
Government of Karnataka and is a constituent college of Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and
Fisheries Sciences University, Bidar. It is the first and only Rural Veterinary College in the state of
Karnataka. The College was inaugurated by the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Karnataka Shri.
Siddaramaiah on 11 th August 2023. The campus is spread over 211 acres of land and is located at
Kokatnur Village at 18Kms from Athani of Belagavi District. Athani is among the remotest taluks in
the state, situated at 150 km from the district headquarters of Belagavi, around 60 km from Sangli,
75 km from Vijayapura and 125 km from Bagalkot.
The College is offering B.V.Sc. & A.H degree programme as per Minimum Standard of Veterinary
Education (MSVE) 2016 regulations of Veterinary Council of India, New Delhi for the students
admitted from the academic year 2024-25. The Campus has an elegant main building housing
various departments, administrative offices, and classrooms; Veterinary clinical complex with
various clinical departments; Separate Boys and Girls Hostel; Library Building, Staff Quarters, ILFC
Block, Post-mortem Building, agriculture land, animal houses etc.
RGR/ACAD/ADMN/4/2025-ACDM-KVAFSU I/74121/2025
7 | P a g e
VII. Dairy Science College, Bengaluru
The Dairy Science College, Bengaluru is one of the premier, reputed and well sought Institutes for
Dairy Technology education in the country. The College was established in 1980 under the erstwhile
University of Agricultural Sciences, Bengaluru in 1980. Since April 2005, it is under the
establishment of the newly carved out University “Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and Fisheries
Sciences University, Bidar”.
The College offering B.Tech (D.Tech), Master’s and doctoral Degree Programme. More than 800
students have been graduated from this Institute, who are serving in nationally and internationally
reputed organizations and acting as our Ambassadors. It is a matter of proud to learn that our Alumni
have spread across the globe and shining so well with their unique contributions and occupied prime
positions in various Dairy and food related organizations which kept the name of Alma Mater at a
high profile. In the journey of last 38 years, Dairy Science College, Bengaluru has produced high
quality Human Resource to cater the need of Dairy and Food Industries. Nearly 90 per cent of the
technical staff of Karnataka Milk Federation are the products of this institute who are acting as
balancing wheel of the Dairy Industry.
RGR/ACAD/ADMN/4/2025-ACDM-KVAFSU I/74121/2025
8 | P a g e
VIII. Dairy Science College, Kalaburgi
The College commenced functioning in the year 2008 with the objective of catering to the
manpower need of the dairy and food processing industries in the country. In the last decade the
Institute has made progress in multiple dimensions, with the support of Government of Karnataka.
Presently, this College is one among the best Dairy Science Colleges in the country and one of the
regional Dairy Science College. The college has accredited by ICAR, New Delhi for financial and
academic support. The College is located at Mahagaon Cross, Kalaburagi 30 KM from the city on
NH 50. The College offering B.Tech (D.Tech) Degree Programme. The College comprises of five
Departments namely, Dairy Technology, Dairy Chemistry, Dairy Microbiology, Dairy Engineering
and Dairy Business Management.
IX. College of Fisheries, Mangaluru
The College of Fisheries, Mangalore, a premier Fisheries Education and Research Institute was established in
1969 by the then University of Agricultural Sciences, Bangalore as the first fisheries college in India under
the agricultural university system of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research, New Delhi. The College has
now become part of the newly established Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and Fisheries Sciences University,
Bidar. The college offering B.F.Sc Undergraduate degree programme and Masters’ and Doctoral
programmes.
RGR/ACAD/ADMN/4/2025-ACDM-KVAFSU I/74121/2025

GUIDELINES AND INSTRUCTIONS FOR ADMISSION TO B.V.Sc. & A.H., B.Tech
(D.Tech) AND B.F.Sc., DEGREE PROGRAMMES UNDER NON-RESIDENT INDIAN (NRI)
or OVERSEAS CITIZEN OF INDIA (OCI) or PERSON OF INDIAN ORIGIN (PIO) / NON
RESIDENT INDIAN CHILDREN /NON-RESIDENT INDIAN SPONSORED CANDIDATES
AT KVAFSU, BIDAR FOR THE ACADEMIC YEAR: 2025-26
General Information to the Applicants:
1. The applicants/candidates should have attained the age of 17 Years and should not have
completed 25 years of age as of 31.12. 2025. No relaxation of the minimum and maximum
age limit is permissible on any grounds whatsoever.
2. The admission shall be based on the merit secured in Qualifying Examination i.e., 12th Standard/
Pre-University Course (PUC), or its equivalent examination (on regular mode) and/or the
entrance examination prescribed for admission to a particular degree programme.
3. If a candidate has not received the original marks card of Qualifying Examination for the
Academic Year 2025 from the concerned Institutions/boards, then the candidate should obtain
the signature of the Principal of the institution where candidate has passed 2nd PUC/12th Standard
examination on the provisional marks card. Internet downloaded marks statement printouts are
not acceptable.
4. In case of International applicants/candidates, if the qualifying examination is other than 10+2 or
12th Standard of India, then the certificates/ transcripts of equivalent qualifying examination
(10+2 or 12th Standard) must have been recognized and approved by the Association of Indian
Universities (AIU). Candidates must submit an EQUIVALENCE CERTIFICATE issued by the
AIU. Candidates may refer to the Website of AIU for more information about the Application
procedure for obtaining Equivalence Certificate.
5. Applications submitted, which are in proper order shall be accepted and mandated till
finalization of the programme applied for. The category once filled in the application form shall
be final and cannot be changed at later stage.
6. The candidates must ensure that duly completed Application along with relevant documents must
be uploaded ONLINE on or before 25.08.2025 (Until 23:59:59 IST).Applications without the
relevant documents shall be summarily rejected.
7. The hard copy of the original application uploaded online and relevant original documents must
be submitted at the time of offline counseling for verification (after online submission, the
original application along with relevant documents uploaded must be downloaded and printed).
8. If any of the information provided in the application or documents submitted is found false either
during counseling or after admission or at any point of the degree programme admitted, such
candidates will be debarred from the admitted course or legal action will be initiated. In such
cases the entire amount of Course fee/Institutional economic fee/ other regular fees paid shall be
forfeited.
RGR/ACAD/ADMN/4/2025-ACDM-KVAFSU I/74121/2025
12 | P a g e
9. Economic fees, admission fees, tuition fee, any other fees and charges will be applicable as per
instructions issued by the University from time to time.
10. Online notification of the candidate’s eligibility for offline counseling or the candidates merely
attending the offline counseling process shall not confirm their right of admission to the course
applied for at KVAFSU, Bidar.
11. The decision to fill or not to fill and modalities to fill the seats remaining vacant due to non-
availability of eligible candidates by NRI or OCI or PIO, NRI’s-C and NRI-S shall rest with the
university.
12. In the event of student discontinuing or cancelling his admission in the middle of the degree
programme, the student has to pay the processing fees as stipulated by the University for
discontinuing or cancelling his/her admission.
13. DISCLAIMER: The statements made and information contained in the Notification / Prospectus
is of general nature for the knowledge of the candidate seeking admission to various programmes
of the university constituent and affiliated colleges. The information contained herein is believed

incurred by any candidate or any other person on account of such amendments, additions,
omissions or errors, no matter how they are caused. The Candidates are advised to visit
KVAFSU https://www.kvafsu.edu.in/admission.html regularly for the latest updates
regarding admission process and other related information from time to time.
14. JURISDICTION: Any dispute/litigation arising out of anything concerned with the university
and its activities, including admissions/operation of Academic & Hostel rules shall be subject to
the Legal jurisdiction of the Hon’ble High Court of Karnataka, Kalaburgi Bench, Karnataka.
Meaning of Terminologies for admission process at KVAFSU, Bidar:
I. NON-RESIDENT INDIAN:
In the case of the general public, an individual being Indian citizen or person of Indian origin is
said to be Non Resident Indian(NRI) in any financial year, if candidate satisfies both of the
following conditions: (i) Candidate resides in India for less than one hundred and eighty two
days (182) during the previous financial year or who stays outside India for employment or for
carrying on business or vocation outside India, or who stays outside India for any other purpose
indicating his intention to stay outside India for an uncertain period. (ii) An Indian Citizen stay
in India for less than 365 days during the four preceding previous financial years and less than
60 days in that financial year.
II. NON-RESIDENT INDIAN (NRI) STUDENTS:
a. Non-Resident Indian students are Indian Nationals studied abroad. They must have had at least 3
(three) years of education in any foreign country during the last 6 (six) years and must have
passed the qualifying examination (12th standard or equivalent) from abroad only and in the
college/ institutes affiliated to Boards of Secondary Education or Universities located in India.
RGR/ACAD/ADMN/4/2025-ACDM-KVAFSU I/74121/2025
13 | P a g e
b.This includes the Indian students studying in the schools or colleges situated in foreign countries
even if they are affiliated to Boards of Secondary Education or Universities located in India, but
will not include students studying in those schools or colleges (situated in India) and affiliated
to the Boards of Secondary Education or Universities of the foreign countries.
c. In case an intervening period/gap is involved, a certificate/affidavit from a Class-I Gazetted
Officer/Notary Public for the entire intervening period/gap showing the candidate’s
preoccupation after leaving the Institution last attended shall be produced by such applicants.
III. OCI / POI CARDHOLDERS
The Ministry of Home Affairs vide Notification dated 4th March 2021 specified the rights to
which an OCI or POI cardholder shall be entitled under the Citizenship Act, 1955. Clause (4)
(ii) of the said Notification reads as under: “(4) parity with Non-Resident Indians in the matter
of, (ii) appearing for the all India entrance tests such as National Eligibility cum Entrance Test,
Joint Entrance Examination (Mains), Joint Entrance Examination (Advanced) or such other tests
to make them eligible for admission only against any Non-Resident Indian seat or any
supernumerary seat:
Provided that the OCI/POI cardholder shall not be eligible for admission against any seat
reserved exclusively for Indian citizens.
The above Notification provides the following Explanation: “The OCI Cardholder (including a
PIO card holder) is a foreign national holding passport of a foreign country and is not a citizen
of India.” Similarly, the PIO cardholder and foreign nationals shall not be eligible for admission
against any seat reserved exclusively for Indian citizens.
IV. NON-RESIDENT INDIAN’S CHILDREN (NRI’s-C):
a. Children of NRI parents/guardians are those who have at least one of their parents/guardians
residing abroad as an NRI. In case of no parents, the guardian must be an NRI residing abroad
and must regard the applicant as his/her ward, as evidenced by an affidavit demonstrating
interest in the student's affairs.
V. NRI SPONSORED STUDENTS (NRI-S):
a) The Sponsorer financing the education of a student must be an NRI and/or blood relation such as
spouse, children (natural/adopted/foster), siblings, paternal uncle/aunt, maternal uncle/aunt,
paternal grandfather/grandmother, and maternal grandfather/grandmother, paternal and maternal
cousins.
b) The Sponsorer possessing a student / visiting visa or temporary visa of any nature from other
countries is not eligible to sponsor. The Sponsorer must produce the proof of the annual income
sufficient to support the course of study of his/her ward.

VI. KARNATAKA DOMICILE:
Eligibility for Karnataka domicile is determined based on fulfillment of one of the following
criteria:
a. The candidate should have studied and passed in one or more Government or Government
recognized educational institutions located in the State of Karnataka for a minimum period of
SEVEN academic years commencing from 1st standard to 2nd PUC / 12th standard as on 1st July
2025, in which the CET is held and must have appeared and passed either SSLC/10th standard
or 2nd PUC/12th standard examination from Karnataka State. In case of the candidate who had
taken more than one year to pass a class or standard, the years of academic study is counted as
one year only.
b. The candidate should have studied and passed either 1st and 2nd Year Pre-University Examination
or 11th and 12th standard examination within the State of Karnataka from an Educational
Institution run or recognized by the State Government and that either of the parents should have
studied in Karnataka for a minimum period of SEVEN years.
